newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen up in line with Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen up in line with Wall Street.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to gain slightly on Wednesday in line with a rise on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.

"The SET index is to continue rising today following gains on Wall Street overnight. The market, however, is not expected to be active as investors await first quarter earnings especially of finance firms which are due to be released later this month," said Bumnan Liumsuwan of Asia Credit.
The composite SET index gained 1.27 points to 715.36 on 3.3 billion baht turnover on Tuesday. The SET-50 index rose 0.19 point to 53.74.
Brokers said most finance companies were to announce first quarter earnings by April 21.
They said foreigners were expected to continue buying fundamental stocks, especially banks and communications firms.
Total foreign net buying amounted to 714 million baht on Tuesday.
